Nvidia’s Credit Risk Is Rising Again

Nvidia’s 5-year credit default swap (CDS) spread has widened to around 79.8 bps, more than 2× its late-May level. Recent market data also showed the spread approaching 82 bps, its highest level since Nvidia’s CDS began trading in late 2025.
